# Parser fixtures

These files are fixtures for `packages/language/scripts/check-parity.mjs`. The canonical user-facing examples live in the website repository under `src/content/docs/examples`. This directory keeps focused parser inputs local to the MCL repository so the language parity check does not depend on another repository at runtime.

The fixtures cover parser and formatter compatibility; they are not a second source of documentation examples. Update them when the parser behavior under test changes.
